payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy algorithm processes bits from LSB to MSB, maintaining count of available boxes of each power-of-two. When insufficient, recursively split the smallest larger box found, counting divisions.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a greedy approach: at each bit, if current sum of available sizes is less than required bits of n, it splits the next available larger box. This exchange argument ensures optimality by minimizing splits.
